overall_scope: One fixed mixed graph on one Ubuntu GitHub runner, one 300000 ms active window, after a successful 32 actor 1000 ms smoke. Reports carry claim=none; this does not establish sustained production availability, churn, process-tree resource usage, or 1000 independent capabilities.

claim_limits.active_window: duration, exact event-counter deltas, and per-timer progress are measured with synchronized instrumentation; this is not a cross-revision throughput comparison
claim_limits.backpressure: this probe uses capacity-one lossless timer fan-in, but does not assert that it saturated; graph_program_services has a separate observed full-queue cancellation regression
claim_limits.native_processes: finite command launch count is recorded; child RSS/CPU and peak concurrent process-tree size are not measured
claim_limits.program_services: service fixture is pure program-module encoding; no child command or worker is launched by service handlers
claim_limits.registry_workers: ordinary applet workers are retained by the registry pool and are expected to reap when the final registry/executor reference is dropped
claim_limits.remote: loopback fixture only; remote server resources are not measured
claim_limits.rss_and_threads: Rust probe process only; sampled RSS may miss short peaks
claim_limits.system: does not certify machine-wide resource ceilings, disk, power, WAN, desktop, or platform fault behavior
claim_limits.thread_admission: graph actor tasks are capped at the requested actor count; remote event readers are separately capped at eight; the probe adds one resource monitor, one loopback server, and one watchdog, while runtime command I/O helpers have no separate probe-wide thread cap

1000_actor_single_trial.layout: 847 timers + 64 native + 16 registry workers + 32 in-process + 32 scheduled services + 8 loopback listeners + 1 collector

worker_reap.ownership: registry-shared ordinary applet pool; graph cancellation joins actor tasks, final registry/executor drop reaps retained workers
